about_the_game:
© THE LEGEND RETURNS 2025

Tonight marks the anniversary. The day he returns. The news calls it a myth—a story to scare people into locking their doors. But you don’t believe in urban legends… until you see him.

What starts as a normal night out quickly turns into a nightmare. A vagabond warns you: no one walks these streets anymore. A stranger whispers, be careful. Then, from the shadows, he watches.

When you return home, strange things begin to happen. Footsteps in the dark. A figure outside your window. You’re being hunted, and no one believes you.

No one… except one cop. Together, you search for answers, but the deeper you dig, the worse it gets. An ancient ritual is the only way to stop him. A single weapon—the only thing that can end him for good.

Do you run, hide, or fight? No one escapes the legend.

  • 🔪 A slasher horror game inspired by PS1 classics. Immerse yourself in a chilling atmosphere with retro graphics, eerie ambient sounds, and a story that will keep you on edge.

  • 🩸 Gore-heavy cinematics with brutal encounters. There’s no easy escape. Every encounter is a fight for survival, with gruesome deaths and intense sequences.

  • 👀 A relentless killer who always finds you. No matter where you hide or how fast you run, he is always near, lurking in the shadows.

  • 🔮 Perform the ritual… or become the next victim. The only way to stop him is to uncover the secrets behind the legend and complete the ancient ritual before it’s too late.

  • 🏃 Pure stealth and survival. Move carefully, use distractions, and find shelter if you want to survive. Running without thinking might be your last mistake.

  • 🔦 Dark and oppressive environments. Dim lighting, the sound of your footsteps, and creaking wood will make you question every move. Are you really alone?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes with intense violence, including cinematics of torture, hangings, blood, and explicit depictions of machete attacks and stabbings. It does not include sexual content. Viewer discretion is advised, especially for players sensitive to extreme violence.
